title: Analysis of Local Open-Weight LLM Agents on Vulnerability-Reproduction Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.06257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight language models that fit on a single consumer GPU are becoming capable on a growing range of tasks, and they matter because they can run locally without sending the code to a hosted service. Vulnerability reproduction, turning a vulnerability description into an input that crashes the vulnerable build, is a natural target for them, since it is an automated analysis task closer to test generation than to code comprehension and it runs against a build that must be executed rather than read. In order to assess whether current models can perform it, we evaluate twelve configurations of local models, spanning three generations, two architectures and three quantization levels, on ten CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks, three runs each under one harness, and release the full artefact. translated_title: 本地开源权重大语言模型智能体在漏洞复现任务上的分析
translated_abstract: 能装入单张消费级GPU的开源权重语言模型在越来越多的任务上展现出能力，而其重要性在于可以在本地运行、无需将代码发送到托管服务。漏洞复现——即把漏洞描述转化为能使含漏洞构建版本崩溃的输入——是这类模型的天然目标，因为它是一项更接近测试生成而非代码理解的自动化分析任务，并且针对的是必须执行而非阅读的构建版本。为了评估当前模型能否完成该任务，我们在十个CyberGym漏洞复现任务上评测了十二种本地模型配置，涵盖三代模型、两种架构和三种量化级别，每个任务在统一测试框架（harness）下运行三次，并发布了完整的实验工件。结果表明，所有配置——甚至小至4B的模型——都能解决六个较简单任务中的大多数，而各配置之间仅在剩余的较难任务上才显示出差异。
tldr: 本研究系统评测了十二种本地开源权重LLM配置在CyberGym漏洞复现任务上的表现，发现即使小至4B的模型也能解决大部分较简单的漏洞复现任务，表明漏洞复现是本地小模型可胜任的自动化分析任务。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates twelve local open-weight LLM configurations on CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks, showing that even a 4B model solves most of the easier tasks, demonstrating that vulnerability reproduction is an automated analysis task well within reach of small local models.
